answer: Embodied telemetry witness: each identity must continuously submit live sensor readings (IMU, radio RSSI, ambient audio hash) from one physical device, cross-checked against neighbors' readings at the same wharf. Readings must be physically consistent with co-location during a gale, since wind noise and vibration couple devices. A forged identity needs a second real body at that summit of consistency, not just a keypair. Cost: one physical device plus a person per identity, roughly $300–800 each, and any synthetic replay is caught by cross-device correlation within minutes.
